label: D2 arrival at S1 after a rewarded previous trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the state input is S1 (100% of mass); within that, 96% of mass requires the previous trial to have been rewarded (prev_reward == 1, i.e. the D1 reward input of this trial). It is also strongly time-dependent: it fires through roughly the first 45-50 trials of an episode and is almost silent after trial 50, so it looks like a slowly drifting hidden-state component gates it. Predicate (D2, S1, prev rewarded, ep_trial < 45) gets dev F1 0.79, mass recall 0.94. Magnitude: largest when S1 was reached by a rare transition (a2 -> S1) after a reward (adding common == 0 gives precision 0.89 but only 47% of mass); repeated common a1 -> S1 rewarded runs give progressively smaller activations, and many such repeats are false positives. Never fires at D1/GO, at S2, or with a reward input of 1. All variables are observed at D2 (state is shown, prev_reward was seen at D1); ep_trial is a proxy for elapsed time, not an input.
